name: Pyramid of Djoser
type: archaeological site; Egyptian pyramids; step pyramid
text: The Pyramid of Djoser, sometimes called the Step Pyramid of Djoser or Step Pyramid of Horus Netjerikhet, is an archaeological site in the Saqqara necropolis, Egypt, northwest of the ruins of Memphis. It was the first Egyptian pyramid to be built. The six-tier, four-sided structure is the earliest colossal stone building in Egypt.

depictions.name: Pyramid of Djoser
depictions.text: The Pyramid of Djoser, also known as the Step Pyramid or Djoser's Pyramid, is an ancient Egyptian pyramid built during the reign of the pharaoh Djoser around 2667 BCE to 2648 BCE. It is the first example of monumental cut stone architecture on Earth, as well as the first pyramid in history. Located in the Saqqara Nome, it was designed by Djoser's vizier Imhotep and later served as the pharaoh's burial site after his death.
